Undo refunds only what you paid. It never rewinds harvests or battles. A purchase already used or involved in claimed progress is protected.
Drag to remove pieces and paths. The hall is protected. Undo restores a whole stroke, provided its sale proceeds are still available. Use two fingers to move around.
Tap a building, decoration or path to select the same piece. Copies use the usual construction price.
Drag a piece to move it. Tap for its actions. Drag empty ground or use two fingers to move the view.
Tap a connected empty area to paint it. Each tile costs the usual price; painting stops when funds run out. Undo reverses the entire fill.
